usages.explain: Expresses the meaning "if not...then...". It is an intimate way of saying 「なければ」.

examples.content: この任務は彼でなけりゃ勤まらない。
examples.transcription: このにんむはかれでなけりゃつとまらない。
examples.mean: This mission cannot be completed without him.

examples.content: 間違えなけりゃ勝てたのに。
examples.transcription: まちがえなけりゃかてたのに。
examples.mean: If I hadn't made a mistake, I would have won.

usages.synopsis:
N・Na + でなけりゃ
A + くなけりゃ
V + くなけりゃ
